cover_letter:
Dear 6thman.digital team,

Your posting says you're looking for someone who designs and builds—not a designer who can read code, not a developer with taste, but both. That's the kind of role I've been working toward, and I'd like to make my case.

At Episto, I design and build client websites in WordPress, own on-page SEO from keyword research to publishing, and work directly with clients—no account layer in between. On mirook.com, I designed the full site structure, built it, implemented structured data and entity markup, and ran iterative technical audits that measurably improved its search health. Before that, I worked as a front-end developer on a healthcare web application, so I understand what happens to a design in the browser: rendering, performance, and the hundred small decisions that make or break a page.

I'll be honest: I haven't shipped a Shopify store yet. But I'm moving into Liquid and Next.js now, and I learn by building real things. What I bring is taste I can explain, a habit of asking why something works, and the willingness to own a store after go-live—not just until handover. I'm early in my career, but I'm hungry, and your junior path describes exactly the kind of fast, hands-on growth I want.

I'd welcome the chance to show you what I've built and talk about where I can contribute from day one.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
